_comment: The adapter's own program (WP-07). `types: []` is the point, exactly as in packages/domain: with no ambient @types loaded, `process`, `Buffer`, `fetch`, `AbortController` and every other platform global are *type errors* inside src/. That is what forces the platform surface to be declared in src/platform.ts and injected rather than reached for, and it is what makes the no-live-calls guarantee structural instead of a convention. Tests read src/ as text and the seed's JSON off disk, so they compile under tsconfig.test.json instead.
